label: Grandstream GWN7803P
description: Grandstream GWN7803P - 28-port Layer 2+ managed PoE switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 (24 PoE+) and 4x 1G SFP uplinks, 802.3af/at, 30 W a port, 370 W total PoE budget from a 400 W supply. 56 Gbps switching capacity, 41.66 Mpps, two-fan 1U 440 mm case.

poe.note: Datasheet Max Total PoE Output Power 370 W from a 400 W integrated supply, Max Output Power per PoE Port 30 W, standards IEEE 802.3af/at. 370 W is the ceiling, not 24 ports x 30 W.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 56 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 28 Gbps, forwarding rate 41.66 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet: 24 PoE ports at 802.3af/at, 4x 1G SFP, 1 console, 400 W supply, 370 W PoE budget, 2 fans, 3.3 kg. Console 115200 8-N-1 into the CLI. Discrepancy: the GWN780x technical-specification page (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/gwn780x-series-technical-specifications/) and the GWN7800 series presentation both state 360 W maximum total PoE output for the GWN7803P, while the model datasheet states 370 W from a 400 W supply; the datasheet figure is what is modelled.
